Based on winit 0.30.13. Linux/X11 XDND accepts HTTP(S) and data:image URIs from browser image drags, preserving escaped URL bytes. They are transported unchanged through the existing PathBuf-based HoveredFile/DroppedFile events; PaintAtlas distinguishes URI sources from local paths and fetches/decodes them off the UI thread. Local file URI decoding and canonicalization remain supported. URI-list comments and localhost file URIs are accepted. Regression tests live in platform_impl/linux/x11/dnd.rs.
The accepted XDND action is Copy, so a source file is never moved or deleted and browsers receive the expected copy action.
